rawTool.wrapper: Non-string code becomes empty and refuses; preserves nonempty original code; filters datasets to string name+array rows then first8. purpose has no observed output echo. Tenant-keyed20/hour in-memory throttle, not durable per-user budget.

httpRequest.admission: code nonblank <=40000UTF16, <=8 datasets; name nonempty; rows array or nonempty text; format json/txt retained else csv; validator sets timeout35000 ignoring caller timeout
httpRequest.notEstablished: No row-element closed schema, name uniqueness, input version/digest, caller task/fence, result authority or hostile object admission demonstrated by these declarations.

httpAdmission.auth: Legacy configured bearer comparison; not a Meri task-bound capability
httpAdmission.effects: HTTP transport invokes separate sandbox; not imported/executed here

outcome.limitQualification: These are source declarations, not evidence measured sandbox limits or native watchdog behavior.

wrapperProjection.artifacts: Transient image metadata includes filename/base64/codeSha256; does not establish durable ArtifactVersion
effects: tenant auditLog write with code hash/dataset names/outcome; failure logged

newContractRecommendation.request: Canonical RunBinding + immutable code ObjectReference/digest + delivered input ObjectReferences + exact environment identity + caller-owned deadline/cancellation/budget. Those are NEW Meri trusted-context requirements, not legacy fields. No second agent loop.
newContractRecommendation.result: Bounded JSON result value (unknown is not permission for arbitrary prototypes), byte-pinned outputs as ArtifactVersion, execution status/duration/exit/output truncation and inspection evidence. Failed/timed-out may have outputs; do not infer ok/exit correlations without defined new protocol.
newContractRecommendation.reuse: Existing authority/lifetime/durable budget and adopted sandbox owner; no copied harness/server implementation.
newContractRecommendation.admission: A pure schema/proposal boundary can proceed; execution, egress, watchdog, task identity, input delivery, sandbox and native validation remain gated.
